texts.title: What the Minutes Omit
texts.author: Manuel Academy
texts.source: Authored for Manuel Academy High School ELA; Academy-held rights.
texts.summary: Meeting minutes plus a participant account that disagree in ways neither resolves; written so 11-12.RL.1 uncertainty is unavoidable.
texts.opening_passage: The minutes record that the motion carried. They do not record that two members later said they had understood the motion to mean something else.

texts.title: The Dissent
texts.author: Manuel Academy
texts.source: Authored for Manuel Academy High School ELA; Academy-held rights.
texts.summary: An original judicial-style dissent with explicit premises, for legal-reasoning analysis without needing a full case record.
texts.opening_passage: I agree with the majority about what the statute says. I disagree that the statute is the only thing here that speaks.

texts.title: Three Sources on a Drought
texts.author: Manuel Academy
texts.source: Authored for Manuel Academy High School ELA; Academy-held rights.
texts.summary: Three sources with genuinely irreconcilable figures, requiring the student to bound rather than resolve the discrepancy.
texts.opening_passage: The state says the reservoir fell nine feet. The district says six. Both are measuring, and both are measuring something real.
